summary: Sealed sports-court car park in open parkland, homes well over 100 m away.
reasons: Park car park, no homes close
Sealed bays with room to spare

drivers.seclusion: Parkland, courts and wetland around; nearest dwellings are over 100 m away across roads.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed access road from Harley Street; wide car park with many bays and aisle space for a van.
drivers.traffic: Arterial road and a motorway just south, but the lot sits well off the lane.
drivers.convention: A few cars park here beside the courts; a park car park, so nobody expects it empty.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 to 8 m elevation, wetland 53 m away
Busy with sport and play in the daytime; likely lit at night
sun_shade: Open sealed lot in full sun; a few small trees shade the south edge.
cannot_judge: Gate or closing time on the car park

best_section.where: Sealed car park south of the tennis courts, east side near the path
